segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu

segments.text_en: First visionary call to build Eninnu
evidence: To the house its king spoke
“I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth.”
“Build his house!,” he ordered him.
On Eninnu, whose ‘me’ is very large, he (Ningirsu) directed his (Gudea’s) eye there.

segments.text_en: Epistemic uncertainty and resolve to consult Nanše
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant, counseled about the message
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know.
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother.
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me.

segments.text_en: Journey and supplication to Ningirsu at Bagara
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
Ningirsu, let me build your house for you, let me make the ‘me’ perfect for you.
His (Gudea’s) prayer was being heard.

segments.text_en: Supplication and filial appeal to Gatumdu
evidence: He sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water.
I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother. I am a no-father-haver, you are my father.
may your good Utukku go in front of me, may your good Lamma follow me on my path.
His cry was heard. His lady, the offering and the prayer, Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea.

segments.text_en: Arrival at Nina and narration of the dream to Nanše
evidence: In the courtyard of the deity of Siraran the governor raised the head to heaven
Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven, his greatness was like the earth.
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand. She had the tablet of the stars on her lap.
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me.

segments.text_en: Nanše's dream interpretation and ritual instructions
evidence: “My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you.”
That is surely Nisaba, my sister.
after you have prepared a chariot for your king
He will reveal the plan of his house to you.

segments.text_en: Crafting ritual gifts and entering Eninnu
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood.
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it.
With his beloved harp, ‘dragon of the land’... to his king, lord Ningirsu, in Eninnu, the white Anzu, he enters.
Joyfully he entered to him in the house.

segments.text_en: Purification offerings and petition for a second sign
evidence: To Šugalam, the terrible place, the place of rendering justice... the governor brought in.
Juniper, the pure tree of the mountain he placed on the fire, cedar incense, the incense of the gods
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not.
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, ‘heart’... I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's epiphany, cosmic promises, and material provisions
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house.
Its terrible radiance reaches the heaven.
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive.
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign.

segments.text_en: Omen confirmation and moral-ritual purification of Lagash
evidence: He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good.
The governor, in his city, like a solitary man he regulated the rites.
A mother does not accuse a son, accusations, a son to his mother does not speak.
The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire.

segments.text_en: Consecration of building implements and platform purification
evidence: He laid down the goat by the box, the mold, he made the brick appear by the goat
(For the) platform, he cleanses 24 ‘iku’ of the city for him, he purifies the platform for him.
Juniper, the pure plant of the mountain, he placed on the fire, The cedar incense, the scent of the gods, its smoke he made.
The Anunna of area-Lagash... with Gudea in offering and prayer, they stood with him.

segments.text_en: Regional levy and international mobilization
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, in the totality of all of his lands.
Its mighty emblem, ‘the king crushes the foreign lands’, standing at the head.
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa.
For the construction of Ningirsu’s house, they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu.

segments.text_en: Procurement and transport of timber, stone, and precious metals
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
From the cedar mountains, cedar beams... by the mighty port of Kasura, Gudea for the Lord Ningirsu moored them for him.
Its large stones, in blocks, he brought
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper... the copper he excavated there

segments.text_en: Devotional vigilance, ground surveying, and ritual preparation
evidence: he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight, he does not set his head to sleep during midday.
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him. Enki made the plan of the house right for him.
the field was right, he measured it, he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself.
For the second time Gudea went out of the shiny city, he sacrificed perfect oxen and perfect goats

segments.text_en: Molding, blessing, and consecration of the first brick
evidence: Ningešzida, his god, leads him by the hand.
Gudea placed clay in the mold. The cultic order emerged.
(About) his brick placed in the mold, Utu was pleased with it.
He placed the brick, he brought the mold into the house, he lifted the brick from the mold, it is a shiny throne raised to heaven.

segments.text_en: Anxious vigilance and divine revelation of Eninnu's separation
evidence: Like a young man building a new house, he does not allow sweet sleep to enter his eyes.
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good. He gave grain to the wave, its appearance was straight.
Gudea lying by the top, he slept, the word dawned on him.
To build his king’s house, the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, was brought to his attention.

segments.text_en: Foundation laying and the sevenfold rising blessings
evidence: Enki places the foundation of the house, Nanše, the daughter of Eridu cared for the omen taking.
Gudea, builder of the house, he placed the basket of the house, a shiny crown, on the head
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground, he gave a blessing
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land.

segments.text_en: Superstructure construction, timber roofing, and stelae masonry
evidence: They make the house grow like a mountain. They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud.
They placed white cedar to be admired in the ‘cedar hall’.
The governor built the house, he made it grow, he made it grow like a large mountain
His large stones brought in their blocks, he brought them in a single year, he worked them in a single year

segments.text_en: Erection and dedication of the commemorative stelae
evidence: His stone erected in the mighty courtyard... as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in Kasurra... as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in front of the rising sun... as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in Baba’s back-room... as name of that stone he named.

segments.text_en: Cosmic manifestation, architectural splendor, and sanctuary feast
evidence: Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu, made it grow like a mountain of Lapis
The arrow leaning against the gate, it is the rainbow leaning against heaven.
They prepare the meal in the great sanctuary, it is gold bowls filled with honey and wine
He built, and after he had finished it, it is the ‘heart’ of the gods, returned to its banks.

segments.text_en: Installation of mythical warrior trophies at the temple gates
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there.
At the frightening place facing the city, the seven heroes he seizes there.
At Šugalam, the gate of radiance, the dragon and the date palm he seizes there.
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place

segments.text_en: Fitting of doors, locks, and cosmic protective aura
evidence: The cedar doors standing in the house, it is Iškur roaring from heaven.
Eninnu, its lock, a bison(?), its pivots, a lion
Keš and Aratta give instructions at the tying (together) of the house
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, like a garment, it covered.

segments.text_en: Provisioning of temple complexes and closing doxology
evidence: From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries
The big fear of the house rests on the land. Its praise reaches the mountains.
Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation.
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised! The building of the house of Ningirsu, this is the middle of the praise.
